detail.longDescription:
I wrote this guide to help others pair Claude Code with a local model as the worker, without all the trial and error I went through.

I wanted the privacy of a local model, so I tested Claude doing the thinking while Qwen on a 24 GB GPU did the typing. How the split works, how Claude reviews and sends work back, and where it falls short.

If you've wondered whether a local LLM can carry real coding work, this is for you.

https://peculiarengineer.com/blog/claude-code-local-qwen-worker/

#ClaudeCodE  #LocalLLM  #SelfHosted
